QuestInfo.name: [Arcana] The Bramble Harp
QuestInfo.0: Perhaps now that you have saved their fellow spirit, the other Tree Spirits will be more willing to help.
QuestInfo.1:
The Tree Spirits are being stubborn.
You should talk to the #rSmall Spirit#k in #b#m450005200##k again.
QuestInfo.2: The Tree Spirits loved the Spirit Tree more than any other group of spirits. Why then, won't they help you save it?

0.msg: #b(The Small Spirit tells the Tree Spirits of your mission to revive the Songblooms, in the hopes of restoring the Spirit Tree.)#k

1.msg: ...So that's how we revived the Floral Flute. What is the Bramble Harp's condition, and where can we find it?

3.msg: You might as well give up.

4.msg: The Spirit Tree has already been corrupted. Even the combined power of all us Tree Spirits couldn't restore it.

5.msg: You're wrong! When the Floral Flute was restored, the Spirit Tree--

6.msg: The corruption can't be purified. Just look at all the Wild Spirits in the forest. They attack other spirits, and they won't listen to reason. Can't you see?

7.msg: Stop wasting your time and find somewhere safe to hide. The Spirit Tree is gone. It's all over.

9.msg: And you, stranger. Leave this forest at once. We give you this one and only warning as thanks for finding our lost friend.

10.msg: #b(The Tree Spirits are stubborn. Perhaps you should speak with the Small Spirit.)#k

0.msg: #b(You should speak with the Small Spirit again.)#k
#b(You decide you have something more important to do.)#k

1.0: I... I thought the Tree Spirits would be happy to help.

yes.0: I used to really like the Spirit Trees... How could they be such jerks?
yes.1: Whatever. I'm not giving up hope!

0.msg: #b(The Tree Spirits are being stubborn. You should back off for now so they don't get any more upset.)#k
